initial.empire:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a TOP-DOWN fantasy strategy game. Create exactly 20 separate detailed hand-painted game miniatures arranged in a strictly regular 5-column by 4-row grid, each centered in its own equal cell, with generous transparent gaps. Landscape 5:4 canvas. No labels, grid lines, bases, scenery, floor, cast shadow, checkerboard or UI.
CRITICAL CAMERA: orthographic overhead, looking down at 75 degrees above horizontal (15 degrees off vertical). Every figure faces NORTH (top of image), seen mainly from ABOVE and BEHIND; show helmet crowns and broad shoulders, short foreshortened body, weapons projecting north; NO upright front-view portraits and NO face-on full-length figures. All share this exact camera and direction, including horses and machines. Clearly readable bold shapes, sharp ink-dark contour, bright silver highlights, clean large colour blocks, strong contrast without excessive tiny surface noise. Premium painted tabletop realism, not chibi. Weapons slightly exaggerated for reading at 32 pixels. Lighting neutral diffuse top-left. Cobalt blue cloth, ivory shields with simple gold insignia, silver armour, dark leather. Consistent person scale and proportions. Entire weapons and wings contained in their cells, each subject occupies roughly 72% of its cell. Only one miniature per cell, except a weapon's attached crew. No duplicate items.
EXACT ROWS, left to right:
Row 1: human captain on foot with blue cape, sword and shield; knight commander on foot ornate silver armour and blue plume; blue-robed wizard with gold staff; tawny gryphon with pale eagle head and outstretched wings; red imperial dragon, wings spread.
Row 2: imperial swordsman shield and sword; heavy foot knight with two-handed greatsword; imperial halberdier broad axe blade on pole; imperial spearman with round ivory shield and long straight spear; heavily armoured knight riding barded blue horse.
Row 3: light cavalry scout riding brown horse, light spear; blue-hooded archer with curved bow; crossbowman with broad transverse crossbow; handgunner with long musket; iron cannon on wooden carriage and compact crew.
Row 4: squat brass mortar on wooden mount and compact crew; armoured steam dreadnought vehicle, brass chimney and riveted steel hull; foot standard bearer holding broad blue flag streaming east; mounted knight standard bearer on horse with broad blue flag streaming east; veteran spearman blue cloak and ivory shield.
Readability and correct bird's eye perspective matter more than cinematic rendering.

ground:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: six-environment seamless-edged ground texture ATLAS for a high-quality top-down fantasy tabletop game. Create ONE landscape image 3072x2048 pixels if possible, exactly 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows of six distinct ground textures. Each tile is a top-down orthographic flat terrain surface, sharp focus, no perspective horizon, no objects, no UI, no borders, no grid lines or labels. Natural hand-painted realism with detailed mineral and plant microtextures. Texture should read as ground under 32 pixel miniature soldiers. Medium-dark restrained colours so bright units stand out. Irregular broad patches and organic material transitions, no repeating tiled geometry.
Tile row1 col1: wooded borderland ground, muted olive green grasses interspersed with ochre dirt, fine stones, leaf litter, patches of moss, a subtle winding earth footpath.
Tile row1 col2: golden plains ground, dry straw grass tufts, ochre earth, trampled grass and fine pale stones, subtle old cart ruts.
Tile row1 col3: desert sand ground, warm dusty tan sand, delicate wind ripples and scattered tiny sandstone gravel, lightly darker eroded patches, no large dunes.
Tile row2 col1: oasis ground, dusty tan soil interspersed with green low grasses and mineral crusts, damp earth, fine silt ripples, sparse tiny pebbles, NO actual water or trees.
Tile row2 col2: red badlands ground, muted terracotta sediment with branching hairline erosion cracks, dark gravel, light sandstone dust, no cliffs or boulders.
Tile row2 col3: ashlands ground, cold charcoal-grey earth with pale ash drifts, small black basalt fragments, faint old cracks, sparse dead tufts, NO lava or fire.
Gameplay constraints: NO boulders, trees, structures, water, pits, walls, large ruins, giant cracks, objects that look like obstacles. The textures fill the ENTIRE rectangular tile edge to edge. No scenic vista. Fine detail but quieter broad centre in each tile. Uniform neutral ambient lighting, no vignette. All six tiles are same camera, material scale, painterly style.
